paragraphs: Mentioned in [Bava Kamma 99b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.99b.22-23): a man who was a money changer in the time of Rav Papa.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked passage introduces money changers and distinguishes an expert from a layperson.
Rav Papa gives Danku (דנכו in the linked Hebrew) and Issur as examples of experts who need no further training.
The discussion goes on to say that even these experts could misjudge an unfamiliar coin from a new press.
